report.summary: Patient P-D008 (41, Medicaid, Lakeshore Community Health Plan, transport benefit confirmed) screened today as having a transportation need. Upcoming primary care appointment (appt:2) on 2026-10-22 at 16:00. No facility location on file, so transit feasibility could not be checked. Best option: Medicaid Ride Line — call the number on his member card at least 2 business days ahead. Paratransit is available but requires ADA certification (up to 21 days). Senior Shuttle West is not applicable (age 41, service is 60+). A medical ride request form exists but needs a Medicaid ID not present in the record; it was not submitted.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Call the number on the Medicaid member card at least 2 business days before the appointment. Patient has a transport benefit.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; decisions take up to 21 days.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM; patient is 41, so not eligible.

options.name: Medical ride request form
options.how_to_access: Form at H2 to check qualification; requires full name, DOB, Medicaid ID, pickup address, and appointment time. Medicaid ID not in record, so not submitted.
